name: Plugin Safety Scanner / 插件安全扫描
description: Statically scans plugins and permitted files in a bounded background worker, reports findings and inspection limits, and offers content-free share-safe exports. Manage other plugins through MT Manager. Open this plugin's settings screen to scan. / 在有界后台工作进程中静态扫描插件及获准读取的文件，报告发现与检查限制，并提供不含原始内容的安全分享报告。请通过 MT 管理器管理其他插件。打开本插件设置页即开始扫描。
